placements.title: Saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer
placements.frame: When a memory is saved, who is enrolled to review it — and how does the suite hold that guarantee?
placements.why: The graph structure is empty — no existing leaf, hub, or stratum holds anything about memory save, review enrollment, or the e2e suite — so nothing can be reused. The grain test admits this as a theme rather than a fact: the probe's own words say the memory 'exists only to carry that assertion', so the assertion is the subject, not the artifact. Review enrollment on save is a behavioral guarantee future envelopes (tests, product behavior, reviewer assignment) will keep feeding, and the position ReviewEnrollmentAssertion carries it as a settled decision rather than a one-time measurement. Minted standalone because nothing existing is even close.
consulted: POSITION VERDICTS: ReviewEnrollmentAssertion (members: src-1); ungrouped: src-2

unconnected.why: A single probe carries one theme; there is no second narrative or position here for a grouping to span, and a thematic stratum over it would only restate the leaf. No categorical, compositional, sequential, causal, or contested relationship is drawn by the content.
